methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2017 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2017 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by online distribution platforms for viewing content could adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services.' At the same time it streams to its own video customers: 'Certain video customers have access to streaming services through our mobile apps and online portal that allow them to view certain live programming and On Demand content and to browse program listings'. The stock trades at 18.0x FY18E — near its own median. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2017 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.56x; +28% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.61; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.5%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.3%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2018-08-31) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.56x (24.3% downside to Bear $28 / +43.3% upside to Bull $53) | Adj composite 2.03 vs market 2.64: gap -0.61 [OVERVALUED] | +28% above the EPP floor $29 (14x FY18E $2.06) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.6% total (+1.8%/yr) | At 18.0x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $49 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -1.8% in Q2 2018, forward revenues +2.1% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2018 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
